EMI.Settings.Title: EasyMagicItems Settings
EMI.Settings.Intro: Configure the default draw experience. World settings are shared by the table; audio preferences are stored on this device.
EMI.Settings.AutoGrant: Add completed items to character inventories
EMI.Settings.AutoGrantHint: The final item is delivered automatically after its reveal is complete.
EMI.Settings.PostChatHint: Publishes the final group result after every participant finishes.
EMI.Settings.SoundHint: Master audio switch. Disabling it silences the opening theme and every EasyMagicItems sound effect.
EMI.Settings.RecommendedDefault: Use recommended item pools by default
EMI.Settings.RecommendedDefaultHint: When disabled, each character begins with the broad pool instead.
EMI.Settings.RegisterAutoGrant: Automatically add completed items to character inventories
EMI.Settings.RegisterAutoGrantHint: When enabled, a completed draw is delivered directly to the matching character.
EMI.Settings.RegisterPostChatHint: When enabled, EasyMagicItems posts a summary after every participant has completed the draw.
EMI.Settings.RegisterRecommendedHint: When enabled, each new draw starts with a character-aware pool. When disabled, every character starts with the broad pool instead.
EMI.Settings.RegisterSoundHint: Master switch for all EasyMagicItems music and sound effects on this device.
